senses.gloss:
ईह् ईह्, i. 1, Ātm. (sometimes Par.)
 1. To aim at, Man. 4, 15.
 2. To desire, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.
 3. To desire to perform, Man. 3, 205.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pres. [] अन्-ईहमान, Not desiring, Yājñ. 2, 116.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass., ईहित, Desired, Prab. 104, 5. n.
 1. Exertion, Man. 9, 208.
 2. Desire, MBh. 1, 1370.
 --Comp.
 आयती-, adj. referring to future time, Rām. 3, 44, 11.
 --With the prep. सम् सम्, To desire, Pañc. iii. d. 87; i. d. 105 (Par.).
 समीहित, n. Desire, Hit. 44, 7.
